rule.message: third-party franchise name; the Hall's theme stays original and never borrows a name from Tolkien, Warcraft or Zelda
rule.source: Site brief for the Hall theme (orchestrator Wave 0 gate spec, 2026-10-08). 'paths' is an exempt-list analogue: docs that explain the ban may name these, content may not. contract_test.py C3 pins the list. Extended to Nintendo and Zelda names and more Tolkien and Warcraft names on 2026-11-02 (decision 90).
rule._note: Case-insensitive for names with one meaning. Case-sensitive for 'Great Forge', 'Lonely Mountain' and 'Middle Earth', so 'a great forge' passes. 'Blizzard' alone is a Colorado weather word; a bare match would block every storm report, so only 'Blizzard Entertainment' and 'Blizzard Games' block. 'Warcraft' covers 'World of Warcraft'. Bare 'Zelda' and 'Link' stay out: both are real first names or common words, and the gate blocks only on the certain, so the series' full title blocks instead. 'Ocarina' alone is an instrument, so only 'Ocarina of Time' blocks. 'Death Mountain', 'Breath of the Wild' and 'Tears of the Kingdom' are case-sensitive like 'Great Forge'. 'Misty Mountains' is case-sensitive too, so 'misty mountains at dawn' passes; 'Mount Doom' and 'Mt. Doom' block in any case. Gimli and Thorin stay out: Tolkien took both from Norse myth, and Gimli is also a town in Manitoba. Bare 'Majora' (a real given name) and 'Mithril' (Mithril Capital, a real VC firm) stay out; only 'Majora's Mask' blocks.
